title: Light over the mesa, green light, missing time and Apache helicopters
place_text: Aztec crash site mesa, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Right after we said it was a 90 degree turn [snorts] and we're uh you know and we're walking back down to the rest of the group and uh it it was instantly over us.

plain: An unnamed camper, out with a group on a mesa near Aztec, New Mexico, where some say a craft once crashed, says he and a friend watched a light make a sharp 90 degree turn. He says that as they walked back to the group it was suddenly right above them, followed by a green light, a stretch of time none of them could account for, and then Apache military helicopters. If true, it would suggest both something unknown and the military were taking an interest in the site.
